    Interval-finiteness of the cover passes from P/μ to P #

    Let μ be a long morphism of a finite ray category P that is neither invertible nor irreducible and occurs in no contour. Then P and P/μ have the same quiver and the same homotopy relation (Bongartz, Indecomposables live in all smaller lengths, lemma in Section 3.1). The residue functor induces a functor of fundamental groupoids (resPhi) with a left inverse on morphisms (resPsi_resPhi), hence an injective map of universal covers preserving arrows (resCoverMap). So interval-finiteness of the cover of P/μ gives interval-finiteness of the cover of P (hullFinite_of_residue).
